description: §22.12 (S460 "n4 b") — the markup compile time admits (meta-emit-form-member-name-pos: `<input name="name">` inside an emitted form) is refused in runtime `meta.emit` output, where the string is data: `name` names an HTMLFormElement member. Nothing written.
rationale: §22.12 *Named properties*: the form half is a run-time rule; dropping it at compile time removed a compile-time refusal only, so compile-time refusals stay a subset of run-time refusals. (ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S460 "n4 b")
